div.p: This case-sensitive code system http://fhir-fli.dev/bumblebee/CodeSystem/disaster-relation-cs defines the following codes:

tr.td: Injury caused by the earthquake, typhoon, tsunami, eruption; drowning; burn.
Illness or injury from the post-disaster environment, or a chronic condition that worsened because the disaster cut off access to care.
A health problem the disaster did not cause and which is not urgent.
Nobody has said. This is the default and it is allowed to stay.
